RELATIONSHIP TO loop-semantic-diff.schema.json (written by the sibling definition-authoring group): that document's inline AuthorityDiffSummary.perCapability / PerCapabilityAuthorityDelta $defs already carry an IDENTICAL per-capability shape (same direction enum: WIDENED|NARROWED|UNCHANGED|ADDED|REMOVED, over the same capability-ids.v1.json authorityLadder) embedded inside a BROADER object (a full nine-category semantic diff plus a four-condition blocking-review group covering more than just authority). title: AuthorityDiff
description: A capability-by-capability comparison of authority-ladder rungs (capability-ids.v1.json authorityLadder) between a 'before' and 'after' state of some other object's requested capabilities — an update candidate release compared against an installed one (loop-installation's forward-pointed update gate), or a fork compared against its parent/upstream (LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §9, FB-RAT-LIN-005). `requiresFreshApproval` MUST be true if and only if at least one `perCapability` entry has direction ADDED or WIDENED (FB-RAT-IMP-008: 'any authority widening... requires fresh approval even for a patch release'; FB-RAT-LIN-005: 'any upstream or fork change that widens capabilities or side effects is highlighted independently of ordinary graph changes') — this schema enforces both directions of that equivalence structurally via the allOf rules below, not merely as documentation.

comparisonId.description: Stable identity for this comparison instance (FB-RAT-COM-002 style).

generatedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this comparison was computed (FB-RAT-COM-004).

comparisonContext.description: Which of this document's two named consumers (or another caller) produced this instance. Informational only — the shape below is identical regardless of context, which is the entire point of extracting it as a standalone document rather than two hand-duplicated copies.

perCapability.description: One entry per capability whose presence or authority rung differs between the two compared states. A capability whose rung is UNCHANGED MAY still be listed (for completeness) or omitted — this schema does not require an exhaustive listing of unchanged capabilities, only that every ADDED/REMOVED/WIDENED/NARROWED capability appear.

requiresFreshApproval.description: MUST equal true iff perCapability contains at least one entry with direction ADDED or WIDENED (FB-RAT-IMP-008, FB-RAT-LIN-005) — see this schema's allOf for the structural enforcement of both directions of that equivalence.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: Forward direction: if any entry is ADDED or WIDENED, requiresFreshApproval MUST be true. A producer cannot set it false while such an entry is present — this document is schema-invalid, not merely policy-violating, in that case.

Reverse direction: if NO entry is ADDED or WIDENED, requiresFreshApproval MUST be false — a producer cannot over-claim a fresh-approval requirement this narrow, capability-only comparison does not actually find. (A caller with OTHER reasons to require fresh approval — e.g. FB-RAT-LIN-005's verification-weakening/destructive-path/schema-breakage conditions — expresses those through loop-semantic-diff.schema.json's separate BlockingReviewGroup, not by inflating this narrower object's boolean.)

AuthorityRung.description: capability-ids.v1.json's authorityLadder, duplicated locally per this repo's standalone-schema convention.

capabilityId.description: A capability-ids.v1.json reverse-DNS ID, e.g. 'fb.device.flash'. This schema validates syntactic shape only; registry membership is a validator-time (LOOP-CAP-001) concern.

before.description: Null when this capability is newly requested (direction=ADDED).

after.description: Null when this capability is being dropped (direction=REMOVED).

direction.description: Same five-value vocabulary as loop-semantic-diff.schema.json's PerCapabilityAuthorityDelta.direction — not a coincidence, the same underlying comparison, deliberately kept name- and value-identical across both documents so a reader who has seen one immediately understands the other.
